tax.text: She supports tax relief for working families and small businesses alongside cuts to wasteful spending.
tax.quote: We need sound money, affordable domestic energy, more competition in health care, and tax relief for working families and small businesses.

debt.text: She says Social Security and Medicare should be protected so seniors can retire securely.
debt.quote: Protect Social Security and Medicare so seniors can retire with dignity and financial security.

housing.text: She supports practical solutions to expand housing supply and make housing more attainable.
housing.quote: Make housing more attainable by supporting practical solutions that expand supply, strengthen communities, and help working families stay rooted where they live.

health.text: She favors more health care competition, price transparency, and alternatives such as direct primary care and telehealth.
health.quote: I support expanding competition, price transparency, direct primary care, telehealth, and reforms that reduce the power of insurance, hospital, pharmaceutical, and government middlemen.

energy.text: She identifies affordable domestic energy as part of her approach to lowering living costs.
energy.quote: We need sound money, affordable domestic energy, more competition in health care, and tax relief for working families and small businesses.

voting.text: She supports accessible polling and absentee voting while also backing voter ID requirements and clear registration rules.
voting.quote: I support clear voter registration rules, reasonable voter ID requirements, accessible polling places, secure absentee voting, transparent ballot handling, and faster public reporting of election procedures and results.

tax.text: He proposes cutting taxes for middle-class families and small businesses while closing corporate tax loopholes.
tax.quote: We can lower taxes for regular Americans without raising the deficit by closing corporate tax loopholes, targeting wasteful government spending, and cracking down on fraud.

wages.text: He says he will seek passage of the PRO Act to strengthen workers' organizing rights and labor-law enforcement.
wages.quote: That is why I will fight to pass the PRO Act, to protect the right to organize by strengthening labor law enforcement and cracking down on companies that illegally fight unions.

trade.text: He says he would oppose NAFTA- and TPP-style trade deals that outsource manufacturing jobs.
trade.quote: I will oppose bad trade deals (like NAFTA and TPP) backed by both parties that outsource manufacturing jobs and support federal programs for companies that hire locally.

debt.text: He says he would oppose raising the retirement age or cutting Social Security benefits and pensions.
debt.quote: I will not allow Washington to raise the age of retirement, cut social security benefits, and play games with workers retirement funds just because their banker buddies want a slice of our pie.

housing.text: He supports affordable-housing programs and incentives for developers to build workforce housing.
housing.quote: I will fight to expand federal and state affordable housing programs, including incentives for developers to build workforce housing, and advocate for tax relief targeted to middle-class families, not billionaires and large corporations.

cannabis.text: He supports further cannabis and hemp legalization and opposes criminalizing people for cannabis.
cannabis.quote: Pharma lobbyists have spent billions of dollars fighting cannabis and hemp legalization not because it's bad for you, but because it's bad for their business.

energy.text: He says he would support legislation to reduce energy costs through grid modernization and competition.
energy.quote: That’s why I will back legislation to reduce energy costs through competition and modernization of the power grid.

tax.text: He supported the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act and praised its tax cuts.
tax.quote: The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act has led to record-low unemployment in Wisconsin, including youth unemployment

wages.text: He opposed a bill to raise the federal minimum wage to $15, citing projected job losses.
wages.quote: $15/hr. does no good if you don’t have a job!

debt.text: He said he would fight to preserve Social Security for current and future retirees.
debt.quote: I’ll fight to protect and preserve Social Security so current and future retirees have the program available to them.

schools.text: He endorsed parents’ ability to choose among public, charter, private, online, and home education options.
schools.quote: we’re grateful for Wisconsin parents’ ability to choose the best K-12 education option for their children, including public schools, charter schools, private schools, online academies and homeschooling.

safety.text: He introduced legislation intended to require schools to report suspected student crimes to police.
safety.quote: If a student commits, or is suspected of committing a crime, police need to know about it.

immigration.text: He called for action on immigration enforcement and said border security was necessary for national security.
immigration.quote: Congress needs to address our immigration crisis now. That is why I am a member of the Border Security Caucus in the U.S. House of Representatives.

guns.text: He said he supports legislation protecting gun rights and opposes undermining the rights of law-abiding gun owners.
guns.quote: I believe the rights of law-abiding citizens should not be undermined.

abortion.text: He said he is committed to protecting life from conception and has supported pro-life legislation.
abortion.quote: I am committed to protecting life from conception to natural death.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He introduced legislation to protect school funding for schools that maintain biological distinctions between boys and girls.
gender.quote: to prohibit the Department of Agriculture (USDA) from withholding federal funds from schools that maintain biological distinctions between boys and girls.

health.text: He supports replacing the Affordable Care Act with a more market-based system and competition among insurers and providers.
health.quote: I support repealing and replacing Obamacare with a more free-market system, while keeping parts of Obamacare that make sense

energy.text: He supported the Keystone XL pipeline, citing jobs, energy security, and lower gas prices.
energy.quote: Not only will it provide thousands of good-paying jobs for hardworking Wisconsin families, but also benefit all Wisconsinites with lower gas prices at the pump.

voting.text: He criticized proposals to expand mail voting and same-day registration without safeguards.
voting.quote: H.R. 1 will force states to implement online voter registration, automatic voter registration, and same-day voter registration with no safeguards.

tax.text: He supports ending the largest tax breaks for people at the top.
tax.quote: I support livable wages, stronger worker protections, and a tax system that stops giving the biggest breaks to the people already at the top.

wages.text: Smith supports raising the minimum wage and strengthening workers’ bargaining rights.
wages.quote: Raise minimum wage, expand apprenticeships, and reward companies that create and expand jobs right here at home.

debt.text: Smith supports protecting and strengthening Social Security, but does not state a position here on Medicare benefits.
debt.quote: I support protecting and strengthening Social Security and pushing back against any effort to weaken it.

housing.text: Smith supports building more affordable housing and expanding options such as duplexes and triplexes.
housing.quote: I support building more affordable housing near jobs and schools, expanding practical options like duplexes and triplexes

schools.text: Smith said his campaign shares a commitment to strengthening public education and supporting educators.
schools.quote: This endorsement reflects our shared commitment to strengthening public education, supporting educators, and ensuring every student has the opportunity to succeed.

immigration.text: Smith supports more legal work pathways and a path to legal status for long-term, law-abiding residents.
immigration.quote: We need more legal pathways for people to work where our economy clearly needs them, along with a realistic path to legal status for law-abiding long-term workers who are already part of our communities.

guns.text: Smith supports universal background checks, red flag laws, and secure storage requirements.
guns.quote: I support common-sense safety measures such as universal background checks, red flag laws, and secure storage.

abortion.text: Smith supports reproductive freedom and access to reproductive health care, including abortion care.
abortion.quote: I support reproductive freedom, women’s right to make their own medical decisions, and ensuring complete access to the full range of women’s healthcare.

gender.text: He says different questions involving transgender people require different rules rather than one blanket policy.
gender.quote: Competitive sports, bathrooms, shelters, housing, and correctional facilities present different considerations and should not be governed by one blanket rule.

health.text: Smith supports a strong public option and building toward universal health coverage.
health.quote: I support protecting and strengthening the Affordable Care Act, lowering prescription drug prices, expanding rural clinics and telehealth, and building toward universal coverage through a strong public option that actually gives people a lower-cost choice.

energy.text: Smith supports a transition to renewable energy, including expanded solar, wind, and electrification.
energy.quote: I support a serious transition to renewable energy and a cleaner economy.

voting.text: Smith supports expanding early and absentee voting, same-day registration, and a national Election Day holiday or paid time off.
voting.quote: I support expanding early voting, no-excuse absentee voting, and making Election Day a national holiday or guaranteed paid time off.

wages.text: He supports raising wages and strengthening labor rights.
wages.quote: I support breaking up monopolies, strengthening labor rights, and raising wages because strong wages build strong communities.

debt.text: He supports taxing Wall Street mega-bank profits to help pay down the national debt.
debt.quote: That is why I support a Wall Street mega-bank tax: profits would be taxed after regular employee pay, but before executive compensation.

immigration.text: He supports due-process protections and legal counsel for immigration detainees to prevent wrongful deportations.
immigration.quote: Guarantee due process by providing access to legal counsel for all detainees to prevent wrongful deportation.

abortion.text: He says abortion decisions should be made by patients and their health care providers, not politicians.
abortion.quote: I support protecting access to contraception and IVF, and I believe reproductive healthcare decisions, including abortion, should remain between a patient and their healthcare provider rather than politicians.

health.text: He supports Medicare for All to provide comprehensive health coverage regardless of income or employment.
health.quote: I support a Medicare for All system that guarantees every American access to comprehensive healthcare regardless of income, employment, or preexisting conditions.

voting.text: He supports expanded early voting, accessible absentee voting, and simpler voter registration.
voting.quote: I support ending partisan gerrymandering through independent redistricting commissions, expanding early voting opportunities, and maintaining accessible absentee voting for eligible voters.

sources: onyourballot.vote411.org · fitzgibbonforcongress.com · thurowforcongress.com · grothman.house.gov · bradsmithforcongress.com · ivoterguide.com · endthecartel.com
